help:
usage: gnd codegen [-h] --out OUT [--force] model

Turn model.orm.yaml into a plain-Python project with the GND shape:
<package>/tools.py (one derived function per fact type, named and
parameterized through the published model-id to Python-symbol mapping, with
docstrings derived from the model's readings), the four-file extraction
artifact bundle under artifacts/, a code-emitted SKILL.md the terminal agent
runs, and create-once extension files (pyproject.toml, references/) that
regeneration never rewrites. No provider SDK and no network library is
emitted, so the generated project is CI-runnable with zero network and no API
key — the agent running the generated SKILL.md is the only place a model is
ever called. Every emitted Python module is parsed before any byte reaches
disk. Re-running over an existing generated project is idempotent: an
unchanged model performs ZERO writes and leaves every hash identical. A
derived file you hand-edited, and an unmanaged file sitting at a derived path,
are REFUSED rather than overwritten; --force overwrites them and still never
touches an extension file. Exits 0 when the tree is written or already
current, 3 when the model is invalid, two of its ids sanitize to one Python
symbol (rename one), or the existing manifest is unreadable, 11 when a write
was refused and nothing was destroyed, 64 on usage errors, 70 when an emitter
invariant breaks over an already-valid model, 74 when the output path is
refused or unwritable.

positional arguments:
  model       path to the model file

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
  --out OUT   output directory for the generated project
  --force     overwrite hand-edited derived files and adopt unmanaged files at
              derived paths. Extension files (pyproject.toml, references/) are
              NEVER overwritten, with or without this flag, and no path
              outside the generated layout is ever touched.
